## Preface

This document imports the `health` questionnaire and shows descriptive statistics for the site.

## Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(LightLogR)
library(glue)
library(readxl)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)

metadata_root <- Sys.getenv("MELIDOS_METADATA_ROOT", unset = "../metadata")
stopifnot(dir.exists(file.path(metadata_root, "scripts")))
remote <- paste0(normalizePath(file.path(metadata_root, "scripts")), "/")

c("labeling",
  "radio_factors",  
  "add_label",
  "prepare_codebook",
  "filefinder",
  "general_parameters",
  "coltype_checker",
  "tables"
) |> walk(\(x) source(paste0(remote, x, ".R")))
```

## Preparation

```{r}
#collect codebook
codebook <- 
  prepare_codebook("MeLiDosScreeningQuestionnaire_DataDictionary_2024-10-16.csv",
                   c("online_screening_consent_form", "your_lifestyle_and_health")) |> 
  filter(!`Variable / Field Name` %in% c("consent", "explanation"))
#collect files
files <- filefinder("screening",individual = FALSE)
#import files
data <- 
  read_csv(files, show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  drop_na(redcap_repeat_instance) |> 
  rename_with(\(x) str_remove(x, "_v2$")) |> 
  mutate(across(medication:disorder, as.logical),
         medication_type = as.character(medication_type),
         drugs = na_lgl)
```

### Resolve repeated assessments and unmatched IDs

The approved selection retains the second assessments for RISE_S007
(28 April 2025) and RISE_S011 (16 June 2025). Literal IDs `1` and `2` are
excluded from the export without assigning them to another participant.
Raw submissions remain unchanged; excluded assessment keys are recorded.

```{r}
assessment_choices <- tribble(
  ~record_id, ~redcap_repeat_instance, ~keep,
  "RISE_S007", 1, FALSE,
  "RISE_S007", 2, TRUE,
  "RISE_S011", 1, FALSE,
  "RISE_S011", 2, TRUE,
  "1", 1, FALSE,
  "2", 1, FALSE
)
selected_assessments <- data |>
  inner_join(assessment_choices, by = c("record_id", "redcap_repeat_instance"),
             relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(selected_assessments) == nrow(assessment_choices))
excluded_assessments <- assessment_choices |> filter(!keep) |> select(-keep)
dir.create("../output/data_quality", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(excluded_assessments, "../output/data_quality/health_excluded_assessments.csv")
data <- data |>
  anti_join(excluded_assessments, by = c("record_id", "redcap_repeat_instance"))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(data$record_id), !any(data$record_id %in% c("1", "2")))
```

```{r}
#check column types
coltype_check <- coltype_checker(codebook, data)
coltype_check$details |> gt()
#collect relevant columns
relevant_columns <- 
  coltype_check$details |> 
  pull(col)
#select relevant columns
data <- data |> select(any_of(relevant_columns))
#label variables
data <-
data |> 
  add_radio_factors(codebook, 
                    var_col = `Variable / Field Name`, 
                    type_col = `Field Type`,
                    levels_col = `Choices, Calculations, OR Slider Labels`
                    ) |> 
  add_col_labels(codebook, var_col = `Variable / Field Name`, label_col = `Field Label`)
#reorder variables
data <- 
  data |> 
  relocate(any_of(codebook$`Variable / Field Name`))
```

## Summarize results

```{r}
#| purl: false
table_health(data)

gtsave(table_health(data) |> as_gt(), filename = "../output/tables/table_health.png", vwidth = 800)
```

### Export

```{r}
data <- data |> rename(Id = record_id)
health <- data
path <- "../data/imported/"
if(!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE)
save(health, file = "../data/imported/health.RData")
```
